title: The Rectangle Theorem
description: Render a centered white rounded rectangle on a black background using a Signed Distance Function. The box has half-extents of (0.5, 0.3) in normalized [-1, 1] space with a corner radius of 0.08. Use smoothstep for anti-aliased edges.
hintText: Start with the standard box SDF: vec2 d = abs(p) - halfExtents. For rounded corners, inset the box by the corner radius r before applying the SDF, then subtract r at the end. Combine length(max(d, 0.0)) and min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0) to handle all regions correctly.
